chinese: 明确的目标能给人方向
english: A clear goal can give a person direction.
soundmark: /ə klɪr ɡoʊl kæn ɡɪv ə ˈpɜːrsən dəˈrekʃən/

chinese: 实现梦想从来都不容易
english: Achieving a dream is never easy.

chinese: 真正重要的是坚持前进
english: What really matters is to keep moving forward.
soundmark: /wʌt ˈrɪrli ˈmætərz ɪz tə kiːp ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd/

chinese: 从错误中学习能让我们更强大
english: Learning from mistakes makes us stronger.

chinese: 我相信努力终将得到回报
english: I believe hard work will pay off in the end.
soundmark: /aɪ bɪˈliːv hɑːrd wɜːrk wɪl peɪ ɔːf ɪn ði end/
